x: Pride of place must surely be given to the four Belgrave boys, Peter Eldridge, Brian Morris, Graham Worrall, and Gerry Leroy, who gained second place in the A.A.A's 4 x 440 yds relay.

BOTTOM RIGHT: Peter Eldridge, Gerry Leroy, Graham Worrall and Brian Morris who broke the existing National club record for the 4 x 440 yd[illegible] relay when finishing a close second to the star-studded Birchfield quartette (Yardley, Farrell, Rawson,Brightwell) in the A.A.A.
John Thresher (1:58.1) and Graham Worrall (52.2) were our winners on the track and the 63 points total scored by the Seniors was only 9 behind that of Q.P.H.

This let in Graham Worrall and Pat (Nanny-Goat) Cornelius and Mike Smithers to take the medals. The 'quarter' developed into a two horse race between Worrall and Pete Pepe, whose form over the hurdles has of late been so encouraging.
